name: Buahan, A Banyan Tree Escape
insider_take: This isn't just another Bali resort – it's a revolutionary no-walls, no-doors sanctuary where luxury meets raw nature in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Buahan defies conventional hospitality with its groundbreaking "no walls, no doors" concept. Each of the 16 elevated villas literally opens to the jungle, featuring retractable glass panels and open-air bathrooms. The property sits dramatically on a ridge overlooking the sacred Ayung River, where ancient Balinese villages dot the terraced landscape below. This adults-only escape operates as a "no news, no shoes" sanctuary – meaning WiFi is intentionally limited and shoes are optional throughout your stay.
pro_tip: Book a villa facing west for front-row seats to Bali's legendary sunsets over the jungle canopy, and don't miss the complimentary sunrise yoga sessions on the floating pavilion.
dont_miss: The signature "Floating Leaf" restaurant literally hovers above the treetops, while the riverside spa treatments use traditional Balinese healing rituals passed down through generations. Adventure seekers can white-water raft the Ayung River directly below the resort or trek to hidden waterfalls accessible only through secret jungle paths known to local guides.
pros: No-walls villa concept with stunning panoramic rainforest views
Unique glamping-style luxury accommodation immersed in nature
Exceptional wellness and spa experiences in pristine jungle setting
Farm-to-table dining with organic ingredients from on-site gardens
cons: Open-air design means limited privacy and weather protection
Remote jungle location requires planning for transportation
